name: @sand/user-tools
description: notify_user and request_secret: the agent tells the user something mid-turn, or asks for a secret its shell commands can use

sand.label: Notices and secrets
sand.summary: Shows the agent's notices in the thread, as toasts and as system alerts while the page is hidden, and asks you for secrets in a password card

uses.server: the agent cannot ask for secrets
uses.shellEnv: the agent cannot ask for secrets
uses.transcript: notices are not shown in the thread
uses.composer: secret requests cannot be answered, only skipped by stopping the turn
uses.settings: system alerts can only be turned on from a notice
